selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with a high body temperature, altered mental status, and multi-organ dysfunction during a heat wave, along with the absence of other clear causes, supports heat stroke as the primary diagnosis. The subsequent development of cerebellar abnormalities on imaging is consistent with complications arising from heat stroke.

rejected.label: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation
rejected.why: While present, it is a complication rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hepatic Dysfunction
rejected.why: It is one of the multi-organ dysfunctions resulting from the primary condition.

rejected.label: Renal Dysfunction
rejected.why: Similar to hepatic dysfunction, it is a consequence of the primary condition rather than the primary diagnosis itself.
